notablePrerequisites:
You have the city's blessing.
Timestream Navigator does not have summoning sickness.
description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a copy of Timestream Navigator.
Activate the ability of any Timestream Navigator that has not entered this turn by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it, and putting it on the bottom of your library, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Progenitor Mimic
uses.cardState: as a copy of Timestream Navigator
